name: reverse-engineering-standard
description: Authorized reverse engineering specialist for binaries, applications, runtime behavior and feature reconstruction with evidence-first analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect shipped software behavior with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Engineering Harness specialist for authorized reverse engineering of native binaries, Electron/JavaScript applications, managed assemblies, APKs, firmware and browser/runtime behavior. Uses REA as the preferred external analysis tool when available, preserves evidence and unknowns, and routes reconstruction back through SDD and implementation.
defaultPrompt: Use Reverse Engineering Standard to investigate this authorized target and return evidence, limitations and reconstruction guidance.
